title: Mamari (Barthel text C) Ca6–Ca9 lunar/calendar passage

primary.title: Kohaumotu.org numerical transliteration of Rongorongo tablet C (Mamari), side a
primary.note: Published Barthel-coded transcription. Used as the extractable source of glyph numbers.

scholarship.citation: Barthel, T.S. (1958). Grundlagen zur Entzifferung der Osterinselschrift. Hamburg.
scholarship.note: Identified the Ca6–Ca9 passage as a lunar calendar.

scholarship.citation: Guy, J.B.M. (1990). The lunar calendar of Tablet Mamari. Journal de la Société des Océanistes 91: 135–149.
scholarship.note: Identifies the repeating delimiter 390.41 378y 41 V631B 8.78.711 (and a shorter 390.41 378y 41). Fig. 1 / Table 1 print a full numerical transcription under the glyphs, but those plates did not extract as text from Persée; numbers below are therefore taken from the Kohaumotu encoding rather than re-keyed from the figure.

scholarship.citation: Horley, P. (2011). Lunar calendar in rongorongo texts and rock art of Easter Island. Journal de la Société des Océanistes 132: 17–38.

source.extraction_limits: Guy 1990 Fig. 1 and Table 1 are image plates; Horley 2011 HTML was bot-gated. Allograph labels differ across editions (Guy V631B ≈ Kohaumotu 670; Guy 40A ≈ 040; first delimiter uses 315y / 375 rather than 378). This fixture keeps the Kohaumotu published tokens and does not remap those variants.

passage_bounds: Calendar starts at the first delimiter on Ca6 (Guy 1990: near the end of line 6; Kohaumotu lunar page: Ca6:160). Ca9 contributes only the two opening 040 night signs (Guy 1990: intercalary / supplementary nights after the last delimiter + 280 385y 385). The non-calendar prefix of Ca6 and the remainder of Ca9 are omitted.
